tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for speaking with me today. Let’s begin with your experience. Do you use social media in your daily life? Which platforms do you use the most and what do you use them for?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你今天抽空交流。我们先从你的经历聊起。你日常生活中会使用社交媒体吗？你最常用哪些平台，用它们来做什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good. Now let’s talk about connection.Do you think social media helps people stay in touch, or does it sometimes make them feel more isolated? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：好的。现在我们来谈谈沟通连接这件事。你认为社交媒体是帮助人们保持联系，还是有时会让人们感到更孤立？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thanks. Here’s another one. Some people say that social media affects how we see ourselves. Do you agree? Why or why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢。再问一个问题。有人说社交媒体会影响我们看待自己的方式。你同意这种说法吗？为什么同意或不同意？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Last question. If you stopped using social media for a week, what do you think would happen? How would you feel?
tasks.analysis: 中文：最后一个问题。如果一周不使用社交媒体，你觉得会发生什么？你会有怎样的感受？
tasks.title: Interview
